objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with episodic cough and shortness of breath.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

“Doctor, for about a month I’ve had episodes of a nonproductive cough and shortness of breath. It gets worse when I climb stairs and especially at night, and I had a fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion about eight weeks ago.”

I’m going to ask a few focused questions to narrow this down.

**Question 1:** During these episodes, do you have **wheezing** (a whistling sound when breathing out) or **chest tightness**?
I haven’t noticed wheezing, but during the episodes I do feel some chest tightness. It tends to come on with exertion, like climbing stairs, and it’s worse at night.
**Question 2:** Do you ever wake up at night **coughing** or **short of breath**, and does it improve when you **sit up** or **use an inhaler**?
“Doctor, yes—I sometimes wake up at night coughing and feeling short of breath, and it does seem to ease when I sit up. I haven’t tried an inhaler yet, so I’m not sure how much it would help.”
**Question 3:** Have you noticed any **heartburn or sour taste** in your mouth, or symptoms that worsen **after meals or when lying flat**?
“Doctor, I don’t really notice heartburn or a sour taste, and I haven’t tied the cough to meals or to lying flat.”
**Question 4:** Do you have any history of **asthma** or allergies (or eczema), or does anyone in your family have asthma?
“Doctor, I’ve never been diagnosed with asthma, and I don’t have eczema or known allergies. I don’t have much family history of asthma either—nothing that I’m aware of.”
**Question 5:** When you had the fever/sore throat/nasal congestion 8 weeks ago, did you get **tested for COVID or flu**, and did the cough start **right after** that illness or only later?

“Doctor, I wasn’t tested for COVID or flu at the time, and I didn’t notice the cough starting immediately after that illness—it seemed to come on later, and has been happening in episodes for about a month.”
**Question 6:** During these episodes, do you have **any chest pain** (sharp, crushing, or pressure-like), or is it mainly cough + shortness of breath + tightness?

“Doctor, it’s mainly the nonproductive cough with shortness of breath and the chest tightness during episodes—I don’t have chest pain, no sharp or pressure-like pain. It mostly feels like tightness with breathing, especially when I’m exerting myself or lying down.”
**Question 7:** Have you had **leg swelling or pain** (especially one-sided), or have you had any recent **long travel/immobility**, surgery, or history of blood clots?
“No, doctor—I haven’t had any leg swelling or leg pain, and I haven’t had any recent long travel, surgery, or past blood clots.”
**Question 8:** Do you have any **history of smoking** (or vaping), or exposure to smoke/chemicals/dust at home or work?
“Doctor, yes—I’ve smoked about half a pack of cigarettes a day for roughly 16 years, and I’m also around smoke at home sometimes.”
**Question 9:** Do you have any **productive sputum** (phlegm) or is it truly **dry**? Any **blood** when you cough?
“Doctor, it’s truly nonproductive—no phlegm comes up—and I haven’t noticed any blood when I cough.”
**Question 10:** Have you had any **unintentional weight loss**, night sweats, or persistent fatigue?
“Doctor, I haven’t had any unintentional weight loss, night sweats, or persistent fatigue—I feel generally the same between the episodes.”
**Question 11:** When you’re not having an episode, do you feel completely normal, or is there **ongoing shortness of breath** even at rest?
Doctor, when I’m not having an episode I generally feel pretty normal, without ongoing shortness of breath at rest. The symptoms mainly come in episodes with exertion and at night.
**Question 12:** Do you have any **history of heart disease**, high blood pressure, diabetes, or do you know your cholesterol is high?
“Doctor, I’ve had long-standing hypertension for about 10 years, treated with enalapril. I don’t have known heart disease, diabetes, or anything I’ve been told about high cholesterol.”
**Question 13:** Have you ever had a **prior similar episode** before this month, or is this the first time?
“Doctor, this is the first time I’ve had episodes like this; before this past month I didn’t have similar nonproductive cough and shortness of breath.”

**Question 14:** During an episode, do you notice **improvement with sitting up** (you already mentioned it helps) and/or **worsening when lying flat**—and do you ever feel **palpitations** or lightheadedness?

(One more question after this, then I’ll give my top differential.)

“Doctor, yes—the symptoms are worse when I lie flat and I feel better when I sit up. I haven’t noticed palpitations or lightheadedness during the episodes, just the nonproductive cough, shortness of breath, and chest tightness.”
[DDX] Asthma, Takotsubo cardiomyopathy, Acute Mesenteric Ischemia, COPD, Toxic exposure
